registration.welcome: Welcome to Artania! You have arrived in a time of great trials. Once a flourishing kingdom, Artania now suffers from a terrible blight — the Beastfever. The Crown seeks bold souls ready to defend our lands and restore peace to these realms. Before the King issues his decree and bestows upon you the powers of Governor, we must know who stands before us. What is your name, warrior?
registration.name_accepted: Greetings, %{name}! Your name is now inscribed in the royal register of Artania. The Kingdom of Artania, once famed for its peaceful hamlets, now withers under the Beastfever, which twists forest dwellers into savage brutes. Your duty as Governor is to rebuild a derelict estate and cleanse the land of this scourge, to bring life back to the ravaged realm. To fulfil this mission you must choose your path:
registration.class.prompt: Which caste will you take up for your stewardship?
registration.class.warrior.desc: the unbreakable shield of the kingdom. You rely on heavy armour and tempered steel to meet the rabid beasts face-to-face and defend your estate in close combat.
registration.class.archer.desc: the keen eye of Artania. Your edge is speed and precise shots from afar, cutting down infected beasts before they ever reach your borders.
registration.class.mage.desc: master of ancient powers. You wield magic to burn the plague with spells or weave wards that cleanse the land and turn back the fiercest predators.
registration.king_oath: The King steps forward and lays a hand on your shoulder: «From this day, you are a Free Governor of Artania. This charter grants you right to an estate and a parcel of land. But I know well — paper will not stop a beast, and law will not guard you from fangs.» The King signals to his servants, and they bring forth a bundle: «Beyond the land, I grant you a weapon. It is the symbol of your authority and the only true defence of your new home. This %{weapon} is now yours. May it never rust, as your heart knows no fear. Go to your estate, Governor. Cleanse the land, raise the walls, and restore Artania to her former glory!»
registration.journey_wolves: The road to your new lands wound through twisted ravines and silent forests. As the silhouette of your manor's old tower appeared on the horizon, the path was suddenly blocked — by them. A pack of rabid wolves burst out from beneath the roots. Their fur is matted, foam drips from their jaws, and their eyes hold nothing but blind fury. They do not wait — they lunge at you all at once, scenting fresh blood and steel.
registration.estate.prompt: Above the entrance to the manor hangs an old plaque, untouched by human hands for ages. You wipe the dust and grime from it. Now that you have proved your claim to this land by the strength of arms, you must give this place a new name. From this day on, it shall be a symbol of Artania's rebirth. %{name}, what will you name your estate?
registration.complete: ✅ Welcome, %{nickname}! Class: %{class} Estate: %{estate} May Artania rise again beneath your shield.
